# Penumbra Tech

> Single-engineer consulting and software practice of Wesley Weaver Jr. Builds full-stack web applications, AWS infrastructure, Unreal Engine systems, and the performance / reliability tooling that keeps it all from quietly falling over. Based in Kitsap County, WA. Sole proprietorship.

The site is a React SPA with server-side pre-rendering — every public route returns fully-rendered HTML, so the prose, code samples, and case studies are all visible without executing JavaScript. The plain-text concatenation of every page is at [/llms-full.txt](https://penumbra-tech.com/llms-full.txt).

## Marketing & positioning

- [Home](https://penumbra-tech.com/): Headline, services overview, featured case studies, testimonial, recent shipping (live GitHub commit grid).
- [About](https://penumbra-tech.com/about): Founder background — Navy nuclear pipeline, Penumbra Group / PC / Productions lineage, how Wesley thinks about systems.
- [Services](https://penumbra-tech.com/services): Four engagement categories — custom software, cloud & backend, game development, performance & reliability.
- [Contact](https://penumbra-tech.com/contact): Cal.com booking, brief-builder prompt for non-technical buyers, contact form, Kitsap location, phone.

## Long-form essays

- [Judgment](https://penumbra-tech.com/judgment): "The judgement is the product." Why engineering judgment is what clients actually buy, with two independent LLM-authored writeups of the site itself integrated as proof artifacts.
- [Stack](https://penumbra-tech.com/stack): Cost transparency — what the $15/month AWS bill behind this site buys versus the $30–$300/month SaaS site builders charge for less.
- [Guide](https://penumbra-tech.com/guide): 13-chapter, ~8,000-word DIY playbook for someone who wants to build a small production web app on AWS themselves. Covers IAM, EC2, swap, MySQL, nginx, PM2, DNS, Let's Encrypt, Express patterns, deploys, backups, security headers, monitoring.
- [SaaS Rescue](https://penumbra-tech.com/saas-rescue): 8-chapter playbook aimed at solo SaaS founders whose backend is on fire. Structural "do it yourself / or hire me" pattern.
- [API Guide](https://penumbra-tech.com/api-guide): Reference for the small public API endpoints the site exposes.

## Case studies

- [Diagnostics](https://penumbra-tech.com/projects/diagnostics): Live load-testing dashboard with k6 + EventSource streaming, head-to-head EC2 vs Lambda+DynamoDB+S3 comparison.
- [Theory of Computation Review](https://penumbra-tech.com/projects/theory-of-computation): Interactive exam-review tool for an upper-division CS course.
- [Repair360 Auto](https://penumbra-tech.com/projects/repair360-auto): Real-world rescue of an automotive shop's broken booking system — what the actual technical challenges were, not a sanitized PR version.
- [Trigonometry Tools](https://penumbra-tech.com/projects/trigonometry-tools): Interactive math learning tool with live geometry rendering.
- [Metaverse Origins](https://penumbra-tech.com/projects/metaverse-origins): Unreal Engine 5 multiplayer game systems, Steam OnlineSubsystem integration, agent-driven content pipeline.
- [Music Visualizer](https://penumbra-tech.com/projects/music-visualizer): Single-file in-browser music visualizer (no install, no cookies, no wifi). Web Audio + Canvas 2D, with from-scratch BPM and musical-key detection. Open source / MIT.
- [Projects overview](https://penumbra-tech.com/projects): Index of all case studies.

## Operational

- [Sitemap](https://penumbra-tech.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for traditional crawlers.
- [Robots policy](https://penumbra-tech.com/robots.txt): Allows general indexing; disallows the auth-walled demo-app surfaces.
